screen.backup.title: Make a backup
backup.title: Make a backup
backup.lead: One file with everything Nocturne holds, locked with a passphrase you choose.
backup.field.label: Choose a passphrase
backup.field.hint: At least 8 characters. A few words that don’t go together are strong and easy to remember.
backup.note.title: Keep this passphrase safe
backup.note.body: Nocturne doesn’t keep a copy. If the passphrase is lost, nobody can open this backup, not even Nocturne. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, or save it in a password manager.
backup.note.check: I’ve written it down or saved it somewhere safe
backup.aside.in.kept: Everything you kept, exactly as kept
backup.aside.in.remembers: What Nocturne remembers, including what’s fading
backup.aside.in.private: Things you marked private, locked like everything else
backup.aside.out.mind.title: Nocturne’s mind.
backup.aside.out.mind.body: A new computer downloads it again during setup.
backup.aside.out.key.title: The key for your provider.
backup.aside.out.key.body: You paste it in again when you turn on online answers.
backup.aside.out.phones.title: Phones you added.
backup.aside.out.phones.body: You add them again in Away from home.
backup.hint.ready: About {size}. Next, choose where to save it.
backup.hint.notReady: Choose a passphrase, type it again and tick the box to go on.
backup.strength.weak: Easy to guess. Three or four words that don’t go together are stronger.
backup.strength.fair: Good. A little longer is even safer.
backup.making.title: Making your backup
backup.making.body: You can keep using Nocturne, or close this window. The backup carries on. Anything you keep from now on goes in your next backup.
backup.making.drive: If you’re saving to a drive, leave it plugged in until this finishes.
backup.stopped.title: Stopped.
backup.stopped.body: Nothing was saved, and nothing in Nocturne changed.
backup.saved.title: Your backup is saved.
backup.saved.holds.label: Holds
backup.saved.holds: {size} · {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}, {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} and {originals, plural, one {# original} other {# originals}}
backup.saved.checked.label: Checked
backup.saved.body: To use it on another computer, install Nocturne there and choose Restore from a backup. You’ll need the passphrase.
backup.fail.off.body: The drive was disconnected before the backup finished, so it wasn’t saved. Nothing in Nocturne changed. Plug the drive back in and try again.
backup.fail.room.body: The drive filled up before the backup finished, so it wasn’t saved. Nothing in Nocturne changed. Free some space, or choose another place.
backup.fail.check.title: The backup didn’t check out
backup.fail.check.body: The file was saved but didn’t read back correctly, so Nocturne removed it. Nothing in Nocturne changed. Try again, or choose another place.
backup.fail.other.body: It didn’t finish, so it wasn’t saved. Nothing in Nocturne changed. Try again in a moment.
backup.fail.cantWrite.title: Nocturne can’t save there
backup.fail.cantWrite.body: That folder doesn’t let Nocturne save files. Choose another place.
advanced.backup.file.pending: A .nocturne file, written as a .partial file until complete
advanced.backup.locking.value: an age file, locked with a key derived from the passphrase by scrypt; the passphrase is never stored
advanced.backup.leftOut.value: engine/ (models), the online answers key, Away from home device keys, logs
screen.restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.lead: Bring back everything from a Nocturne backup file. Nothing on this computer changes until you say so.
restore.lead.setup: Moving from another computer? Choose the backup you made there, then type its passphrase.
restore.field.label: Passphrase for this backup
restore.aside.checks: Checks the whole backup before anything changes
restore.aside.brings: Brings back what you kept, what Nocturne remembers, every page and your settings
restore.aside.puts: Puts anything already here aside, so you can bring it back
restore.aside.online.title: Online answers
restore.aside.online.body: stay off until you paste the key for your provider again.
restore.aside.away.title: Away from home
restore.aside.away.body: stay off until you add your phones again.
restore.wrong: That passphrase doesn’t open this backup. Check capital letters, and try again.
restore.wrong.many: That passphrase doesn’t open this backup. If you saved it in a password manager, copy it from there.
restore.bad.title: This file can’t be restored
restore.bad.body: It isn’t a Nocturne backup, or it’s damaged. Nothing was changed. If you have another copy, try that one.
restore.newer.title: This backup is from a newer Nocturne
restore.newer.body: It was made with Nocturne {theirs}, and this computer has {ours}. Update Nocturne on this computer, then try again. Nothing was changed.
restore.newer.body.generic: It was made with a newer Nocturne than this computer has. Update Nocturne on this computer, then try again. Nothing was changed.
restore.checking.title: Checking the backup
restore.checking.label: Checking
restore.checking.body: Nocturne reads the whole file first, so nothing changes unless all of it is there.
restore.damaged.title: Part of this backup is damaged
restore.damaged.body: Nocturne can’t restore it safely, so nothing was changed. If you have another copy, try that one.
restore.gone.title: The backup file went away
restore.gone.body: Nocturne couldn’t finish reading it, so nothing was changed. If it’s on a drive, plug it back in and try again.
restore.noRoom.title: There isn’t room to restore
restore.noRoom.body: This computer needs {needed} free to restore this backup, and it has {free}. Free some space, then check again.
restore.noRoom.body.generic: This computer needs more free space to restore this backup. Free some space, then check again.
restore.ready.title: Ready to restore
restore.ready.holds.value: {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}, {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} and {originals, plural, one {# original} other {# originals}}
restore.confirm.title: Replace what’s on this computer?
restore.confirm.body: Restoring puts what’s on this computer now aside, then brings in the backup. Nothing is deleted. You can bring back what was here from Privacy.
restore.confirm.already: Something is already put aside from {day}. It stays, and this is put aside as well.
restore.restoring.title: Restoring your memories
restore.restoring.label: Restoring
restore.restoring.body: Keep Nocturne open until this finishes. If it closes, nothing on this computer changes and you can start again.
restore.restoring.finalNote: Almost done. This last step can’t be stopped.
restore.stopped: Stopped. Nothing on this computer changed.
restore.restored.title: Your memories are back.
restore.restored.lead: {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}, {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} and {originals, plural, one {# original} other {# originals}} from your backup of {day}.
restore.restored.mind.here: Already on this computer. Nothing to do.
restore.restored.mind.missing: Downloads next, during setup ({size}). Your memories and pages are here meanwhile.
restore.restored.online.body: Off until you paste the key for your provider again.
restore.restored.online.later: Off until you paste the key for your provider again. You can do that in Settings later.
restore.restored.away.body: Off. Add your phones again when you want them.
restore.restored.before.body: Put aside {day}. Bring it back any time from Privacy.
advanced.restore.file.pending: A .nocturne file, read in full before anything changes
advanced.restore.format.pending: Read once the passphrase opens the file
advanced.restore.format.value: backup format {format} · data schema {schema} · made by Nocturne {version} on {date}
advanced.restore.contents.pending: Read once the passphrase opens the file
advanced.restore.contents.value: {size} · {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}} · {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} · {originals, plural, one {# original} other {# originals}}
advanced.restore.checked.pending: Every part is checked before anything changes
privacy.backup.title: Back up to one file
privacy.backup.body: Everything in one file, locked with a passphrase you choose. Use it to keep a copy somewhere safe, or to move to a new computer.
privacy.backup.interrupted: Your last backup didn’t finish, so it wasn’t saved.
privacy.backup.restore.kept: Restoring didn’t finish, so Nocturne kept what was here. You can try again from Privacy.
privacy.backup.putAside.label: Put aside before restoring
privacy.backup.bringBack.title: Go back to what was here before?
privacy.backup.bringBack.body: What you restored from the backup is put aside instead, so you can still change your mind.
privacy.backup.delete.title: Delete what was put aside?
privacy.backup.delete.body: {memories, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}}, {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} and {originals, plural, one {# original} other {# originals}} from before {day}. This can’t be undone.
